feat(esc): complete Gprinter ESC/POS V1.6 surface

Add the remaining handbook commands (charset, bitmaps, barcode HRI,
kanji, cut/beep, cash drawer, network, 2D symbols, page mode, macros)
plus GprinterResponseParser in all six languages. Shared golden bytes
live in test/resources/gprinter/v1.6-golden.json. Excel A4 frames and
the parent-method safety lock stay in place.
